csv_project_name: DB for Mobile District AOR Unrestricted
csv_scope_of_work: This project is a Best Value, two-phase design-build solicitation. A detailed project description and overall project performance requirements for this project will be included in the Request for Proposals (RFP) package. The solicitation criteria relies upon industry standards, where allowable, to afford the offeror a degree of design flexibility while meeting certain specific project requirements. The successful Contractor must design and construct complete and usable facilities, as described in the RFP documents. One solicitation will be issued covering both phases. Proposals will be evaluated in Phase One to determine which offerors will submit proposals for Phase Two, and an amendment will be issued to those selected offerors. Selection of offerors for involvement in Phase Two will be based on technical approach and performance capability. Detailed project design requirements will then be added by amendment to the solicitation at the start of the Phase Two stage of the Request for Proposals. A target of seven firms will be invited to participate in the second phase.

title: Design-Build for Mobile District Area of Responsibility
short_description: Two-phase design-build procurement for complete facilities in Mobile, Alabama.
project_scope: Best-value two-phase design-build solicitation for the design and construction of complete and usable facilities within the Mobile District area of responsibility. The detailed project description and performance requirements will be provided in the RFP package and supplemented for shortlisted phase-two proposers. The procurement allows design flexibility within specified performance requirements. Total construction cost is stated as a range of 25 million to 65 million USD.
services: Design-build services including design and construction of complete facilities; phase-one evaluation based on technical approach and performance capability; phase-two submission with detailed design requirements added by amendment.
relevance_explanation:
- General building design-build procurement with no specific structural, architectural, or long-span features described.
- Scope is too generic to identify a strong fit with sbp's focus on bridges, special structures, stadiums, or complex lightweight structures.
- Primarily a contractor-led design-build opportunity rather than a clearly defined structural engineering planning mandate.
- Could involve buildings, but no evidence of large, complex, or architecturally demanding structures.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated as the midpoint of the stated tender range of 25.0 million to 65.0 million USD.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated in the tender notice. Only a total construction cost range of 25.0 million to 65.0 million USD is provided; the exact building type, scope, and engineering share are not defined, so no reliable sbp fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Phase-one selection is based on technical approach and performance capability. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided notice.
award_criteria: Best value procurement. Phase-one evaluation based on technical approach and performance capability; selected offerors proceed to phase two. Detailed phase-two criteria are not stated in the provided notice.
